title: Airbnb Payout Payout Amount Leaderboard
dataSources: Airbnb bookings (`airbnb:booking`), Vrbo reservations (`vrbo:reservation`), Airbnb payouts (`airbnb:payout`), and guest reviews (`guest:review`).
app: Airbnb booking exports, Vrbo reservation webhooks, Airbnb payout statements, guest review logs, and turnover checklists streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=airbnb:payout payout_usd=*
| stats sum(payout_usd) as total_value, avg(payout_usd) as avg_value by listing_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks listing values by total and average payout amount across Airbnb payout events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `payout_usd` values for each Airbnb payout event and review total and average payout amount by listing.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total payout amount.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates which listing shows the biggest payout amount numbers in your Airbnb payout data.
